name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for classic car restoration, spending countless hours in his grandfather's workshop meticulously rebuilding engines. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he specialized in precision manufacturing. After graduating, Ricardo honed his skills at a local automotive factory, quickly rising through the ranks due to his keen eye for detail and dedication to quality.

He transitioned to motorsport five years ago, initially working with a smaller racing team before being scouted by Aston Martin. As a quality control specialist, Ricardo is responsible for ensuring that every component meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. He is known for his rigorous testing protocols and his unwavering commitment to perfection. Ricardo believes that meticulous attention to detail is crucial for success on the track and considers himself a vital link in the team's overall performance.

What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to quickly identify potential flaws and devise innovative solutions to address them. He is a strong advocate for continuous improvement and is always looking for ways to optimize processes and enhance the team's competitiveness. His dedication to quality and proactive approach make him a valuable asset to Aston Martin.
